task: TASK-029 CPTAC-UCEC external replication of TASK-028 F34 (sealed frozen design)

sealed_design_authority.scoring_code_reused_verbatim: task028-freeze-b-draft/execution/scripts_v3/scoring.py (ssgsea_matrix, area_regulon) + model_engine.py (build_design, fit_ols, subtype_emms, contrast_estimate, bootstrap_contrasts, bh_fdr) -- imported, not re-implemented

cptac3_ucec_rna.gene_universe: GENCODE v36, 60660 genes (identical to TASK-028 frozen universe)

confirmatory_subtype_roster.source: Dou 2023 Cancer Cell mmc2.xlsx (Elsevier CDN), Meta_table, Genomic_subtype

discovery_subtype_roster.source: cBioPortal ucec_cptac_2020 GENOMICS_SUBTYPE (sealed join table discovery_join.json)

cohort.dedup_rule_k: one patient = one primary-tumour analytic unit; keep study-primary aliquot (lowest sample-vial suffix); deterministic tie-break

model: V2 FROZEN NO-PURITY: score ~ subtype + M4 proliferation (covariate-only) + ESTIMATE composition; NO purity in primary

inference.scoring: per stratum, no raw-expression pooling; M1 ssGSEA (F2 sensitivity); M3 signed VIPER/aREA over 761 signed edges; orphans excluded; all-zero rule
inference.effect: standardized d = contrast/sigma_resid per stratum; patient bootstrap n_boot=2000
inference.meta: inverse-variance FIXED-EFFECT over the two strata; opposite-direction veto
inference.family: F1 = BH-of-6 across {C1: LHX1,PAX8; C2: GATA2,HOXA9,SOX9,WT1}
inference.replicated_criterion: ALL of: pre-specified direction; |d|>=0.5 + bootstrap CI excl 0; BH q<=0.05; stratum-consistency; no critical QC/model failure
